title: Auren skill manifest
description: Schema for the skill.json manifest inside a skill package. The manifest may request capabilities but can never grant itself permissions; requests are validated against the application security policy during installation.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version. Only version 1 is currently supported.

id.description: Stable skill identifier in lowercase kebab-case; used as the installation directory name.

entrypoint.description: Package-relative entry point. For declarative skills this is the path to the primary tool definition directory or file. Absolute paths and '..' segments are rejected.

implementation_type.description: declarative: composes existing registered tools. Executable implementations are not supported in the first release.

minimum_app_version.description: Minimum application version required by this skill.

required_integrations.description: Provider types the skill needs at execution time (for example "gmail"). Missing integrations leave the skill partially configured and unavailable for execution.

required_permissions.description: Requested capability names. The manifest cannot grant itself permissions; requests are validated against the application security policy, and effective authorization is decided at invocation time.

tool_name.description: Tool name as exposed to agents; unique within the skill version.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the tool's arguments.

implementation_ref.description: Registered tool being referenced. Required when implementation_type is builtin_ref.

tools.description: Tools declared by this skill. Every referenced tool must exist in the registry at validation time.

dependencies.description: Identifiers of other skills this package depends on.
